title: GET /books?author= (empty value) filters by empty author instead of listing all
evidence: Sources/BookAPI/Router.swift:44 reads request.query["author"] which is "" for a bare ?author=, then BookStore.all(author:) runs WHERE author = '' returning an empty list
suggestion: Treat an empty author query value as no filter (nil) so ?author= behaves like GET /books

title: Server uses Connection: close — one request per TCP connection
evidence: Sources/BookAPI/HTTPServer.swift:90 cancels the connection after each response; HTTP.swift:serialized() sends Connection: close
suggestion: Acceptable for the task; keep-alive would improve throughput but is out of scope

title: Test suite requires full Xcode (XCTest not shipped with CLT alone)
evidence: README.md notes Xcode is required to run tests; test_coverage=1.0 in scores.json confirms tests built and passed in this environment
